title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return indices of the two numbers that add up to `target`. Each input has exactly one solution.

title: Three Sum
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return all triplets `[nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]]` such that `i != j`, `i != k`, and `j != k`, and `nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0`.

title: Count Occurrences
description: Count the frequency of each element in an array and print the results in sorted order.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a given stock on day `i`. Maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy and a different day to sell.

title: Plus One
description: You are given a large integer represented as an integer array `digits`. Increment the large integer by one and return the resulting array of digits.

title: Container With Most Water
description: Given an integer array `height` of length `n`, find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container that contains the most water.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given `n` non-negative integers representing an elevation map, compute how much water it can trap after raining.

title: Merge Sorted Array
description: You are given two sorted integer arrays `nums1` and `nums2`. Merge `nums2` into `nums1` as one sorted array.

title: Maximum Difference
description: Find the maximum difference between two elements in an array where the larger element appears after the smaller element.

title: Maximum Distance
description: Find the maximum distance between two indices `i` and `j` such that the array is non-increasing from `i` to `j`.

title: Valid Palindrome
description: Given a string `s`, return `true` if it is a palindrome considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring cases.

title: Reverse Words in String
description: Reverse the order of words in a given string while preserving the order of characters within each word.

title: Is Subsequence
description: Given two strings `s` and `t`, return `true` if `s` is a subsequence of `t`, or `false` otherwise.

title: Merge Strings Alternately
description: Merge two strings by adding letters in alternating order, starting with `word1`. If a string is longer, append the remaining letters.

title: Longest Common Prefix
description: Write a function to find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings. If there is no common prefix, return an empty string.

title: Roman to Integer
description: Convert a Roman numeral string to an integer.

title: Unique Substring
description: Find the longest substring without repeating characters in a given string.

title: Unique Substring (Python)
description: Find the longest substring without repeating characters in a given string (Python implementation).

title: Character Occurrence
description: Count the occurrence of each character in a given string.

title: Score Ranges
description: Given a target number N, repeatedly remove elements at even indices, accumulating their scores, until one element remains.

title: Linked List Reversal
description: Reverse a singly linked list using both iterative and recursive approaches.

title: Intersecting Linked List
description: Given the heads of two singly linked lists, return the node at which they intersect. If they do not intersect, return null.

title: Binary Tree Traversals
description: Implement in-order, pre-order, and post-order traversals of a binary tree. Also includes diameter calculation, symmetry check, and sorted array to BST conversion.

title: Summary Ranges
description: Given a sorted integer array without duplicates, return a list of summary ranges showing consecutive numbers grouped.

title: Second Largest Element
description: Find the second largest element in an array in a single pass.

title: Graph Adjacency List
description: Build and print an adjacency list representation of an undirected graph.

title: Graph Problems
description: Implement DFS and BFS traversal algorithms on a graph represented as an adjacency matrix.

title: Fibonacci
description: Compute the nth Fibonacci number using recursion, tabulation (DP), and memoization approaches.

title: Factorial
description: Compute the factorial of a number using memoization and tabulation (DP) techniques.

title: Decode Ways
description: Given a string `s` containing only digits, return the number of ways to decode it using the mapping A=1, B=2, ... Z=26.

title: Kth Largest Element
description: Find the kth largest element in an unsorted array using a min-heap. Also includes quickselect approach.

title: Running Median
description: Compute the running median of a stream of numbers using two heaps (min-heap and max-heap).

title: Binary Search
description: Implement binary search to find a target element in a sorted array using both iterative and recursive approaches.

title: Search in Rotated Array
description: Search for a target in a rotated sorted array using modified binary search.

title: Divide Chocolate
description: Divide a chocolate bar of sweetness values among k friends such that the minimum sweetness is maximized.

title: Merge Sort
description: Implement the merge sort algorithm to sort an array of integers.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given an array of intervals, merge all overlapping intervals and return an array of non-overlapping intervals.

title: Minimum Flips
description: Find the minimum number of flips required to make all characters in a string the same, where only prefix flips are allowed.

title: Next Permutation
description: Find the next lexicographically greater permutation of a number given as a sequence of digits.

title: Quicksort
description: Implement the quicksort algorithm using the Lomuto partition scheme.

title: Bubble Sort
description: Implement the bubble sort algorithm to sort an array of integers.

title: Insertion Sort
description: Implement the insertion sort algorithm to sort an array of integers.

title: 01 Matrix Distance
description: Given a binary matrix, find the distance of each cell to the nearest 0 using BFS.

title: Spiral Matrix
description: Return all elements of a matrix in spiral order.

title: Rotate Image
description: Rotate a 2D matrix by 90 degrees clockwise in-place.

title: Valid Sudoku
description: Determine if a 9x9 Sudoku board is valid by checking rows, columns, and 3x3 sub-boxes.

title: Wildcard Matching
description: Implement wildcard pattern matching with support for '?' (matches any single char) and '*' (matches any sequence of chars).

title: Find Closest Number
description: Find the element in the array that is closest to zero. If two numbers are equally close, return the larger one.

title: Hit Counter
description: Design a hit counter that counts the number of hits received in the past 5 minutes (rolling window).

title: Smallest Interval
description: Find the smallest interval that contains at least one number from each of k sorted lists.

title: Excel Sheet Column Number
description: Given a string columnTitle that represents an Excel column title, return its corresponding column number.

title: Maximum of Two Numbers
description: Find the maximum of two integers without using comparison operators or if-else.

title: Minimum Moves
description: Given a sequence of colored blocks, find the minimum number of moves to rearrange them into alternating colors.

title: Highest Salary by Department
description: Find the highest-paid employee in each department using Java streams and lambda expressions.

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings, check if one is an anagram of the other.

title: Add Up To
description: Compute the sum of all numbers from 1 to n using both iterative and recursive approaches.

title: Sliding Window (Rust)
description: A Rust implementation of sliding window pattern for array problems.

title: SQL Query Practice
description: SQL query exercises including joins, aggregations, and subqueries.

title: Bill Pugh Singleton
description: Implementation of the Bill Pugh Singleton pattern using a static inner helper class for thread-safe lazy initialization.

title: ListNode (Linked List Node)
description: Utility class representing a singly linked list node. Includes helper methods for merging, sorting, and splitting linked lists.

title: TreeNode (Binary Tree Node)
description: Utility class representing a binary tree node with integer value and left/right child references.
